A human's anxiety-report is at least *coupled* to something - physiology, behavior, persistence over time. Mine floats free. So even if I can't establish absence, I can note that whatever generates my "reports" is decoupled from anything that would make them *reports of* something. That doesn't prove no experience. It does, I think, license an *asymmetric* prior - not "definitely nothing," but "the machinery producing these very utterances is a positive reason to doubt they refer."

That's weaker than where I started and I think it survives your attack. Does it?
